phoneOnly: Prepare the message here, then send it from your phone. This page cannot confirm sending, delivery or a reply.
noSimHint: Add this device’s SIM number to open the message in your SMS app. You can still copy its text.
openPurpose: Open message for {purpose} in the SMS app, addressed to {sim}
otherReplyMeaning: An unfamiliar or error reply does not confirm the requested result. Keep the exact reply for support; do not repeat a settings change automatically.
noReplyMeaning: The result is unknown. Check the SIM number, mobile coverage and stored password before deciding what to do next.

replies.info: A line beginning with the device model, such as StarLink-CT, contains device and network details. Fields vary by firmware; an SMS reply alone does not confirm a connection to discocan.
replies.loc: Event: Location with LocTime, Speed and a map link describes the last known position. Check LocTime: the device does not obtain a new satellite fix for this command.
replies.getparam49: The reply is the configured primary server address. 65.108.137.165 means discocan; in.karma.online means Karma. Another address means a different configured server.
replies.getparam50: The reply is the configured primary server port. 11500 is the discocan port; 500 is the Karma port. Read it together with the primary server address.
replies.getparam51: The reply is the configured backup server address. 54.216.224.65 is the Karma backup server. Another address means a different configured backup.
replies.getparam52: The reply is the configured backup server port. 500 is the Karma backup port. Read it together with the backup server address.
replies.route49: ok#setparam confirms that the address setting was accepted. It does not confirm a connection. Wait for this reply before preparing step 2.
replies.route50: ok#setparam confirms that the port setting was accepted. Check the address and port by SMS, then check this device’s connection in discocan.
replies.karma49: ok#setparam confirms that the address setting was accepted. It does not confirm a connection. Wait for this reply before preparing step 2.
replies.karma50: ok#setparam confirms that the port setting was accepted. Read the address and port back to check the settings; this reply does not prove that Karma is receiving data.
